augmentation, DEV recall at the served threshold 0.5 rises.

regions; scale and colour augmentation) and does not separate them. That is accepted and
must be stated in the result.

recipe.optimizer: Fresh AdamW; no optimizer, scheduler or patience state carried over

scale: Random factor, then crop or pad back to the tile; boxes and masks transformed with the
image; an instance left with no pixel is handled the way the existing zero-pixel policy
augmentation.colour: Brightness, contrast and saturation jitter of at most +-0.2

budget.early_stop: Three epochs without an improvement of at least 0.001 in DEV recall at 0.5
relaunch: One relaunch from the last saved epoch is allowed after a runtime fault (crash, driver,
disk), recorded in the ledger; never after a disappointing number.

rule: Among epochs passing the filter, the highest DEV recall at 0.5; a tie goes to the earlier

action: Exactly one Karnataka holdout run of that epoch at 0.5 with the frozen evaluator, entered in

improved.action: No holdout run; the lead decides.

rejected.condition: anything else, or no epoch satisfies the selection filter
rejected.action: No holdout run, no further training; the failure ledger gets the signature.

transfer: No transfer evaluation: Cox's Bazar has no attempt left; Chittagong's preregistration

loss: Staging holds one loss implementation, revision ulpin-rfdetr-empty-mask-scalar-chunked/2
(B6b). It is the B3 objective with the mask terms summed in chunks, CPU-proven equal to
upstream in values and gradients (scripts/ml/test_chunked_mask_loss.py). The /1 code of
b3/run1-config.json is no longer on staging and rfdetr_loss.py is read-only for this task,
so the run records revision /2. No loss change is made here.
